messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to meloxicam.
Signs of an allergic reaction to meloxicam include hives, difficult breathing, and swelling in your face or throat.
Get emergency medical help if you have a severe skin reaction.
Signs of a severe skin reaction include fever, sore throat, burning eyes, skin pain, and a red or purple skin rash with blistering and peeling.
Get emergency medical help if you have signs of a heart attack or stroke.
These signs include chest pain spreading to your jaw or shoulder.
These signs include sudden numbness or weakness on one side of the body.
These signs include slurred speech.
These signs include leg swelling.
These signs include feeling short of breath.
Meloxicam may cause serious side effects.
Stop using Meloxicam and call your doctor at once if you have:
the first sign of any skin rash, no matter how mild;
shortness of breath (even with mild exertion);
swelling or rapid weight gain;
signs of stomach bleeding - bloody or tarry stools, coughing up blood or vomit that looks like coffee grounds;
Triplet: ["meloxicam", "has symptom of serious side effect", "sudden numbness or weakness on one side of the body"]

The relation 'has symptom of serious side effect' in the triplet is defined as 'An occurrence of the serious side effect caused by the subject drug may present with the symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
E. 'has side effect location': The adverse effect caused by the subject drug occurs at the location specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
